notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Cat creatures.
description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Gemstone Array's abilities any number of times.
